body.name: elimTok
body.def: A token \(\ell=(\operatorname{op},L,Z)\) has \(\operatorname{op}\in\{\operatorname{sum},\operatorname{district}\}\), a nonempty ordered kernel-label list \(L\), and a nonempty vertex set \(Z\); it denotes either marginalization of \(Z\) from the product of the labelled kernels or its unique proper-district factorization.
